description: Fault test cases for series compensated transmission line with the capacitor at the middle of the line is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Tanbhir Hoq (KTH The Royal Institute of Technology). Description This data set contains time series data of different simulated fault cases in high voltage series compensated transmission lines. The simulation is done in PSCAD using the Python automation library. The capacitor is located in the middle of the line. The model of the line is given in the attached pdf file. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2021. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
